source_records.addendum_title: Phase 1 addendum — corrected and frozen damage-model contract

cases.title: Advantage attack
legal_choices: resolve attack with maximum of two d20 rolls

cases.title: Studied Attacks carry
legal_choices: Advantage only on the next same-target attack after a final miss
event_order: set Studied only on final miss
resolve second attack with current Studied state
establish a fresh Studied benefit if the second attack is a final miss
prohibited_alternatives: grant Advantage before an observed final miss
retain the prior Studied benefit after its next same-target attack
suppress a fresh Studied benefit after a new final miss

cases.title: Combat Prowess hit instead
legal_choices: convert observed miss to ordinary noncritical hit

cases.title: resistance floors each outcome
event_order: floor packet damage divided by two

cases.title: half on successful save
legal_choices: floor half per damage outcome on successful save
prohibited_alternatives: inspect damage roll before save resolution

cases.title: saved rider
legal_choices: resolve failed-save full and successful-save half branches

cases.title: rider repeatability
legal_choices: non-signature on at most one strike
prohibited_alternatives: repeat non-signature in one Attack action

cases.title: Tier 2 allowance
legal_choices: use at most one Tier 2 rider per Attack action
prohibited_alternatives: two Tier 2 riders in one Attack action
fail to reset for Action Surge Attack action

cases.title: Overload Mastery activation
event_order: apply choice for rest of turn
prohibited_alternatives: decline then activate later that turn

cases.title: standalone action replacement
prohibited_alternatives: two standalone actions during Action Surge

cases.title: cluster targeting
legal_choices: primary plus every legal secondary up to cluster remainder

cases.title: generic on-hit superiority damage
prohibited_alternatives: use after Precision on same attack

cases.title: Precision with declared static AC
legal_choices: spend d8 knowing required correction is 3
prohibited_alternatives: add an on-hit die after Precision

cases.title: superiority pool exhaustion
prohibited_alternatives: spend two dice from pool one

cases.title: Relentless while pool nonempty
event_order: choose at most one die per attack
prohibited_alternatives: stack two dice on one hit

cases.title: GWF GWM and Graze
event_order: roll each weapon die with GWF floor
cases.formula: E[max(d6,3)]=4; greatsword=8/16; Attack flat=5+1+3; Hew flat=5+1

cases.title: nominal critical Hew
legal_choices: same-weapon immediate follow-up outside Attack action
prohibited_alternatives: more than once per Fighter turn

cases.title: finite kill Hew with another target
legal_choices: retarget Hew to living B after A dies
event_order: transition A positive HP to zero

cases.title: finite kill Hew with no living target
critical and kill create one Hew entitlement
legal_choices: one Hew follow-up after critical that also kills
prohibited_alternatives: one entitlement for critical plus one for kill

cases.title: Hew Bonus Action same-weapon and target legality
legal_choices: immediate same-weapon follow-up only when BA and legal target exist
event_order: check living target in finite mode
cases.formula: legality conjunction: BA && same_weapon && (nominal_target || living_target) && hew_token

cases.title: optional True Strike
legal_choices: zero or one replacement per Attack action
event_order: choose ordinary or True Strike pre-roll
if True Strike choose base mode

cases.title: level 11 schedule
prohibited_alternatives: average per action instead of per round

cases.title: level 15 Studied schedule
legal_choices: next same-target attack consumes Studied and hits
prohibited_alternatives: grant more than one missed attack per scripted turn

cases.title: level 20 Prowess schedule
legal_choices: convert first miss each Fighter turn
prohibited_alternatives: more than one Prowess use per turn

cases.title: finite one-die distribution
prohibited_alternatives: credit raw damage above HP as actual

cases.title: finite adaptive retarget
prohibited_alternatives: precommit second target before observed death when choice is later

cases.title: simultaneous finite packet
legal_choices: resolve one atomic simultaneous multi-target packet

cases.title: Thermal Fracture chronology
legal_choices: first qualifying hit applies reduction only after resolving itself
prohibited_alternatives: first attack benefits from its own reduction

cases.title: finite Ball Lightning cohort and timing
legal_choices: apply starts only to still-living cohort members
event_order: activate in R1 with no immediate packet
R3 start only for living B
cases.formula: R2 actual A3+B4 overkill1; R3 B4; total actual11, overkill1, kills1

cases.title: Mass Levitation excluded
cases.formula: unsupported state => no legal nominal action

cases.title: finite cohort key
cases.formula: key=(primary_hp,sorted(secondaries)); secondary swap equal, primary swap unequal

cases.title: shared declared static target surface
legal_choices: give every provider the same immutable typed snapshot
event_order: attach finite dynamic HP only in finite view
supply equal view to each provider
reveal random outcomes only at resolution
cases.formula: canonical provider snapshots are byte-equal; future field intersection is empty

cases.title: True Strike radiant_base wins
prohibited_alternatives: apply Slashing immunity to Radiant upgrade

cases.title: True Strike weapon_normal_base wins
prohibited_alternatives: move Radiant upgrade into Slashing packet

cases.title: True Strike typed packet rounding and critical dice
cases.formula: hit combined E[floor((d8+d6+6)/2)]=27/4 vs split=13/2; crit combined=43/4 vs split=21/2; raw crit=22

cases.title: finite policy separation and earliest exhaustion
event_order: compare exhaustion CDF at pre-horizon keys
cases.formula: HP-removed chooses H because 10>8; kill-cleave chooses K because 2>1; (1,1) lexicographically beats (0,1)
prohibited_alternatives: promote kills from HP-removed policy as kill headline
